description: Defines the MockCertVerifier class used for testing certificate verification, including methods to add verification results, manage observers, and simulate verification behavior.

classes.name: MockCertVerifier
classes.description: A mock implementation of CertVerifier for testing certificate verification logic.

classes.name: CertVerifierObserverCounter
classes.description: An observer that counts how many times the CertVerifier's change notification is triggered.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Performs certificate verification, can be configured to return preset results.

methods.name: SetConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration for the verifier (empty implementation).

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to the verifier.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer from the verifier.

methods.name: set_default_result
methods.description: Sets the default verification result for unspecified cases.

methods.name: set_async
methods.description: Configures whether Verify() returns results asynchronously.

methods.name: AddResultForCert
methods.description: Adds a verification result for a specific certificate.

methods.name: AddResultForCertAndHost
methods.description: Adds a verification result for a specific certificate and hostname.

methods.name: SimulateOnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Simulates a change event for observers.

methods.name: CertVerifierObserverCounter
methods.description: Counts how many times the verifier change event is triggered.

methods.name: OnCertVerifierChanged
methods.description: Increments the change count when verifier change event occurs.
